points.text:
all C atoms are $\text{sp}^2$ hybridised

bonds between C atoms are $\sigma$ and $\pi$

$\text{C-C}$ $\sigma$ bonds are formed by overlap of $\text{sp}^2$ hybrid orbitals

$\text{C-C}$ $\pi$ bonds are formed by overlap of p orbitals

bonds between C and H atoms are $\sigma$

$\text{C-H}$ bonds are formed by overlap of $\text{sp}^2$ hybrid orbitals and s orbitals

Any two [1], any four [2], all six [3]
At least 2 correct listed bonding statements.
